---
applyTo: "**/*.cshtml,**/*.js,**/*.css,**/*.scss"
---

# MVC / Bootstrap / jQuery / DevExtreme Instructions

- Bootstrap controls responsive layout and general UI structure.
- Use DevExtreme for data-heavy grids, filtering, lookups, export, and administrative workflows.
- Use semantic HTML for simple forms/content.
- Keep JavaScript business logic minimal; authoritative decisions belong on the server.
- Avoid inline JavaScript when practical.
- Do not rely on a hidden/disabled button or client validation for security.
- Encode untrusted output.
- Keep forms keyboard accessible and provide visible labels/validation messages.
- For DataGrid server operations, validate authorization and permitted filters on the server.
- Add or update Playwright coverage for critical UI workflows.
